description: Look up EU-canonical terms across 24 official EU languages in the EU's authoritative terminology record. Returns the authoritative EU term, domain, reliability rating, and equivalents in your target language. Accepts single terms or multi-word phrases. Used for professional translation and interpretation, using domain terminology sourced from the EU's own authoritative record.

target_lang.description: Target language for the returned equivalent term

term.description: Term or phrase to look up (in any of the 24 EU languages)
